name: VWMA
description: This is a price action keyword on volume, meaning areas with higher volume will have a greater weight. On heavy volume days, the VWMA will more closely follow price, and on lower volume days the VWMA will act similarly to a simple moving average
how_to_use_markdown:
This is a price action keyword on volume, meaning areas with higher volume will have a greater weight. On heavy volume days, the VWMA will more closely follow price, and on lower volume days the VWMA will act similarly to a simple moving average

![Example](./images/img-1766487570.png)

You can plot VWMA on the following series, like close in the above example, you can also plot VWMA of  OPEN, HIGH, LOW, CLOSE

Read more about VWMA here  -  www.patternswizard.com/vwma-indicator/
